meta.name: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
meta.description: With humour, absurdity and family cat and mouse at its center, this is a tale of family gangsters in a fictitious madhouse city, Bindiya. As the current Don is put behind bars, the gangster family's alliances shift, new love, friendships, and betrayals explode until Bindiya becomes a full-blown circus-where love is a deal, power is personal, and every one has a card and blood on their hands.

videos.title: The Davan Empire
videos.overview: Tensions erupt in Bindiya around the land next to Bindiya River, forcing Chhote Davan to negotiate peace through grit. As Chhote dreams of contesting elections, his father Bada Davan publicly snatches the spotlight, triggering emotional turmoil, betrayal that sets off a deadly political chess game.

videos.title: The Davan Family
videos.overview: Bada Davan is jailed for murder, but his family is torn over whether he's guilty-or being set up. Everyone in the family seems to have their own agenda and are searching for the missing ₹25 crore that could decide the future of Bindiya. Babu risks his career to uncover the truth, while Chacha takes over power.

videos.title: Colonel Kaun?
videos.overview: With Bada Davan in jail and the family empire splintering, Chhote galvanizes public support while Chacha hunts 25 crores hidden by the dead Accountant, Lala. As both grow in power, Bada shocks them by triggering a ruthless vote within the gang to decide who becomes the next Colonel. What begins as political survival turns into emotional betrayal and a dangerous war within.

videos.title: Family Tandoor
videos.overview: Sukki forces support for Chacha in the Colonel vote, but chaos breaks loose for Davan Family when his ego collides with mockery. Chhote fends off Murli's blackmail while juggling Ajji's dowry drama and a fractured family. As every Captain picks sides, the coup is officially underway within the family as well as outside the family.

videos.title: Poonch Main Lathi
videos.overview: As new colonel is chosen, Chhote demands from Chacha to have no more deals with Bhamirs. Meanwhile, Kisna takes his first steps in Davan family business by threatening and bribing Murli. As Chacha schemes with Bhamir Anant Singh, a 25-crore liquor convoy heads to Patna-until on Chhote's tip, Murli's STF ambushes the route.

videos.title: War Hoga
videos.overview: While Chhote hides 25 Crore election cash in four different portions, Babu finds that love of his life is mistress to his own brother Chhote. Chhote offers Kisna crores to leave Bindiya and Murli plots surveillance on everyone. Chacha is kidnapped by Bhamirs and the episode ends with a call for War.

videos.title: Pakka War Hoga
videos.overview: As Chhote negotiates a high-stakes deal with Bhamirs betraying his fathers command, hidden family tensions explode. Imli manipulates him for control, while old rivalries resurface through blackmail and sex scandals. A viral exposé turns Bada into a political sensation, triggering vengeance and tragedy that culminates in a devastating fall that can only result in War.

videos.title: Shopping
videos.overview: Bada defies party orders from prison, sending Chhote to Patna to secure his election ticket. As Chhote’s charm clashes with elitist politics, Imli seduces Baccha, Ajji steals hidden cash, and Babu’s obsession with Sasha spirals into danger. Meanwhile, Murli has a perfect plot to bring next one down in the Davan empire.

videos.title: Ek Aur Davan Gaya
videos.overview: Chhote’s failed ambush exposes deep family cracks while Kisna’s first kill haunts him. Ajji secretly steals what's not hers, and Murli arrests Sasha to trap Chhote. The episode races toward Roli’s explosive courtroom arrival and a fatal setup in motion.

videos.title: Koi Nahi Apna
videos.overview: Roli’s testimony sparks chaos as Dharavi shatters the case against Bada, revealing a larger conspiracy. Bhamir's attack Moda Village for revenge and making a way for their Powerplant ambitions, using Police, Raja Babu and Vikram Singh. Babu abducts Roli to find who is actually behind His fathers arrest. Chhote defies Bada, declaring independence and political ambition and father and son finally comes to a break that will last forever.

videos.title: Gaanv Chhodab Naahi
videos.overview: In this pivotal episode, Chhote orchestrates a deadly trap under the guise of reconciliation—convincing rival Vikram Singh to apologize to Moda Village's resilient residents, only to push him into an enraged crowd where rape victim Soni exacts her fiery revenge. While the village celebrates their defiant stand against displacement, internal family fractures deepen: Ajji steals Chhote's hidden fortune to fund her medical dreams, Kisna siphons money for personal ventures, and Babu's forensic investigation reveals Chacha's betrayal in Bada's arrest.  The episode climaxes in catastrophic violence transforms from a bachelor party venue into a massacre site.

videos.title: War
videos.overview: Kisna's bachelor party at the Yadav Recreational Club erupts into a bloodbath when Babbal Banna and Raja Babu's militia launch a coordinated siege, transforming celebration into carnage.  Chhote arrives with an LMG-mounted mini truck for a dramatic rescue, but the cost is devastating Myra suffers severe sword wounds from Babbal Banna, As survivors escape through bomb-rigged tunnels to a secret Davan hideout, Chhote calls Anant Singh with a chilling promise—he's abandoning politics for pure gangsterism, vowing vengeance that will reshape Bindiya's power structure forever.
